rexxFlow.customCssFile.markdownDescription: Optional path to a `.css` file used to override the control-flow webview styling. Relative paths resolve from the current workspace folder and are disabled in untrusted workspaces. Files larger than 64 KB are ignored.

rexxFlow.defaultView.markdownDescription: Default control-flow webview mode. `graph` opens with advanced details collapsed; `detailed` opens the diagnostics and control panels expanded.
